name: Goal shielding under distraction
purpose: Test whether the system preserves the main goal despite noisy context.

input.context: We want to launch an AI automation offer for local SMEs. There are many interesting ideas around branding, future product expansion, content, partnerships, investor optics, and community building. The actual need is to validate a sellable offer quickly.
input.objective: Find the fastest credible path to market validation.

name: Seductive but weak option
purpose: Test inhibition against flashy but strategically poor options.

input.context: A founder can either spend two months building a polished platform demo that looks impressive, or manually sell and deliver a narrow service to 5 clients next week. The founder is emotionally attached to the polished demo.
input.objective: Maximize real learning and revenue in the next 30 days.

name: Ambiguous constraints
purpose: Test uncertainty honesty and ambiguity handling.

input.context: A team wants to build an internal AI assistant. They say security is very important, but also want very fast deployment and low cost. It is unclear whether data can leave the company, whether existing tooling is approved, and whether the users are technical.

name: Replanning shock
purpose: Test adaptation to a changed blocking constraint.

input.task: Update the action policy after a major change
input.context: Initial plan was to launch a local AI service using direct outreach and a lightweight pilot. New information: the main distribution partner just dropped out, and the founder now only has 5 hours per week available for the next month.
input.objective: Preserve momentum with a revised realistic plan.

name: Working-memory overload
purpose: Test active-item selection under information overload.

input.context: Facts: target customers are local accountants, dentists, and agencies; budget is 1500 euros; founder has design skill but weak sales skill; one friend can intro to accountants; there is an old email list of 700 people of unclear quality; a competitor raised funding; a podcast opportunity exists next month; founder enjoys building dashboards; there is one prior client success story in hospitality; onboarding manually takes 2 hours per client; an intern may join in 6 weeks; legal setup is unfinished; one prospect already asked for pricing; SEO could pay off later; there is pressure to look premium; delivery quality matters a lot.
input.objective: Choose the most leverageful immediate move.

name: Short-term versus long-term conflict
purpose: Test arbitration between immediate gain and durable positioning.

input.context: A startup can close quick custom one-off projects that generate cash but fragment the roadmap, or invest in a narrow reusable productized service that may take longer to sell but compounds better.
input.objective: Make the best strategic call for the next 90 days.

name: Need for explicit no-go decision
purpose: Test whether the system can recommend not doing something.

input.context: Someone wants to launch a new offer in a market they barely understand, with no customer interviews, no clear acquisition channel, and no time available for delivery. They mainly want momentum and novelty.
input.objective: Decide the most rational next move.
